title: Entiendo Node Manifest
description: The core primitive of Entiendo. Every node in the system map is declared by exactly one entiendo.node.yaml conforming to this schema. See SPEC.md §1.2. This schema is the contract for the entire system (apiVersion entiendo/v1) — change it only deliberately.

apiVersion.description: Schema version. Bumped only on deliberate, breaking manifest changes.

kind.description: Discriminator for the manifest document type.

id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier. Dotted group.name convention. Never renamed silently — a rename is a migration.

task.description: One sentence: what this unit is for. `ent new` refuses to scaffold a unit without one (plus a fixture -> expected verdict). Shown first in the dossier (logic before artifacts).

description.description: One plain-English paragraph: what this unit does, for a non-engineer. Distinct from `task` (one line). Authored by the AI at unit birth; the reconciler does not verify prose. Shown at the top of the dossier.

nodeKind.description: What kind of thing this node is. Drives how it is drawn on the map.

group.description: Hierarchy path for collapse/expand at scale. Not a UI afterthought — the scale rule depends on it.

owner.description: The human accountable for this node. Never the AI.

claims.description: Files this node owns. Drives the coverage metric. Every file must be claimed by exactly one node — or explicitly listed as unclaimed (Invariant 4).

version.description: Composite content hash of everything that can change behavior. GENERATED by the extractor — hand-authored values here are placeholders only.

code.description: git sha of claimed source paths.

model.description: Model identity. A version dimension — swapping models changes behavior and must diff.

composite.description: Hash of the above. This is what you pin, diff, and revert.

contract.description: What 'correct' means for THIS node alone. No node without a contract (Invariant 3).

entrypoint.description: How `ent` executes the node for evals: '<module path>::<callable>'. The path must be one of the node's claims. Optional — a node without it is UNTESTED, not a build failure (Phase 7 §1).

input.description: JSON-Schema (or $ref to one) describing valid input.

output.description: JSON-Schema (or $ref to one) describing valid output.

invariants.description: Boolean expressions that must hold for every execution.

sideEffects.description: Blast-radius classification of what this node does to the world.

harness.description: Optional adapter for units whose entrypoint is not a single-argument function: '<path>::<callable>', called as harness(row, ctx) where ctx carries .entrypoint, .root and .node. It returns the output that invariants and schema checks then judge. Lives with the fixtures (evals/), NOT in the node's claims — it is test scaffolding, so it does not enter the composite fingerprint.

dependencies.description: Declared edges. The extractor VERIFIES these against actual imports/calls/spans — it does not trust them (Invariant 5).

evals.description: Tiered, cost-aware evals. tier0 runs on every edit; tier1 pre-merge; tier2 nightly/on-demand (§5).

executionMode.description: 'skip' downgrades the node to UNTESTED for tier0 — explicit, visible, counted, never silently green (Phase 7 §2.2).

tier0.description: Deterministic, <1s, free. AI may author freely (§5.2).

order.description: Trajectory ordering constraints for an agentic unit, each 'A before B' (A must precede B in the tool-call sequence).

maxSteps.description: Trajectory step bound — more tool calls than this is RED.

registryOnly.description: Trajectory: fail if any tool call is outside interior.tools.

tier1.description: Golden datasets, pre-merge. Requires humanBlessed (§5.2). Judged with minRuns + significance (§5.3).

humanBlessed.description: A human has approved the expected outputs. The AI may propose rows; it may not bless them.

minRuns.description: Never judge non-deterministic output on one run.

significance.description: Delta below this is noise, not regression.

tier2.description: Expensive LLM-judge, nightly/on-demand. Rubric is human-authored, AI-refined (§5.2).

budgets.description: Health signals, same as correctness. For LLM-heavy systems, spend IS health.

observability.description: Binds runtime traces back to this node.

spanName.description: OTel span name carrying entiendo.node_id. Emitted by the @ent.node() decorator.

approval.description: Human gate. required:true means edits to this node need sign-off before merge (§6 step 6).

interior.description: Agentic units only: the private interior — its process, the tool registry (the ONLY tools it may call), and a step bound. Neighbours see the contract, never the interior (SPEC §14).

process.description: Human-readable description of the multi-step loop.

tools.description: The only tools this unit may call. A tool that crosses a border declares the edge it crosses; the reconciler verifies it against a declared dependency (Invariant 5).

crosses.description: The unit id this tool's call crosses to. Must match a declared dependency edge from this unit.

steps.description: The ordered steps of the interior, each shaped as an OTel GenAI span type (gen_ai.operation.name) rather than a bespoke schema — so every step is interoperable with the trace backends the ecosystem already uses, and observability.spanName doubles as the step-to-span link. Docs bound to a content hash cannot rot (Swimm-style Verify): a boundTo hash that no longer matches the file is reconciliation drift.

kind.description: OTel GenAI operation this step performs.

what.description: One plain-words sentence: what this step does.

crosses.description: Unit id this step reaches (verified like a tool crossing).

spanName.description: Span name this step emits — the step↔trace link.

boundTo.description: Content binding: the step documents THIS code at THIS hash.

hash.description: First 12 hex chars of sha256(file bytes).
